select d.TRADE_ID as tradeId,
acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID as prodId, acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME as prodAbbr, d.busi_type as busiTypeCode, d.busi_type as busiType, (case when d.finprod_type = 'F02' then 'F02orF04' when d.finprod_type = 'F03' then 'F03orF05' when d.finprod_type = 'F04' then 'F02orF04' when d.finprod_type = 'F05' then 'F03orF05' else d.finprod_type end) AS finprodTypeCode, d.PS as psCode, d.PS as ps, d.COUNTER_ID as counterId,
DATE_FORMAT(d.TRADE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as tradeDate, DATE_FORMAT(d.vdate,'%Y-%m-%d') as vDate, DATE_FORMAT(d.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') as mDate, ftp.TERM_TYPE as termType, d.ccy as ccyCode, d.ccy as ccy, d.CHL_ID as chlId, d.PRIN_AMT as prinAmt, d.PRIN_AMT as firSetAmt, ftp.INT_RATE*100 as intRate, d.prin_amt/ftp.prin*ftp.m_trade_amt as expSetAmt, d.prin_amt/ftp.prin*ftp.m_int_amt as intAmt, ( CASE WHEN instr('T20,T25;T21,T26', d.ps) >0 THEN d.INT_AMT ELSE NULL END ) as tranAmt, ( CASE WHEN instr('T27', d.ps) >0 THEN d.INT_AMT ELSE NULL END ) as divAmt, tdf.FEE_AMT as tdFeeAmt, d.TRADE_AMT as tradeAmt, d.fee_amt_pay as feeAmtPay, d.fee_amt_unpay as feeAmtUnpay, DATE_FORMAT(d.pay_date,'%Y-%m-%d') as payDate from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d
left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD e on d.trade_id = e.trade_id
inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = d.TRADE_ID inner join BOK_BOOKSET book on deal.BOOKSET_ID = book.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO acct on acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B09' left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO cust_out on cust_out.customer_id = d.counter_id left join FIN_PRODUCT cust_in on cust_in.finprod_id = d.counter_id left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp on ftp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id where d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{prodId}
